**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve the backup shutdown timeout and error contract**

When a responder takes between 5 and 10 seconds to exit after SIGTERM, this newly raised exception bypasses `backup_recovery._quiesce_responder`, which imports this helper and intentionally allows `RESPONDER_STOP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS = 10.0`. The backup CLI catches only `BackupError` and `ValueError`, so it now aborts after five seconds with an uncaught traceback instead of waiting its documented bound and reporting `responder_stop_unverified`; either keep this helper's boolean contract or translate/configure the timeout in the backup caller.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
